rule_title: TTP 1003.006 - DCSync Confirmed: Network Logon Burst Followed by Replication GUIDs (Step Rule)
description: High-confidence DCSync step rule correlating the Mimikatz network authentication pattern with the replication GUID access. Mimikatz DCSync opens multiple rapid-fire Kerberos network logons (4624 LogonType 3) from the attacker IP before issuing replication requests — this burst of logons from a non-DC IP followed immediately by 4662 replication GUID access from the same LogonId is the definitive Mimikatz DCSync sequence.
